title: Donut craft his father showed him
summary: Dave Rossi tells of Donut craft his father showed him, about undated at Rossi's old house, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: My father said to me, "Hey, come take a look one time one of the three times." And it was your typical it was like a donut shaped craft.

plain: A man named Dave Rossi says his father once called him over at their old house to take a look at something in the sky. According to Rossi, it was a typical donut-shaped craft, on one of three times such things appeared; he tells it on Jesse Michels' podcast in 2025.
